capacity_source: Cushman & Wakefield data analysed by Computer Weekly, table republished by OfficeChai 19 Sep 2026
hyperscaler_regions: AWS live (Aug 2024); Microsoft Malaysia West live (2025); Google: Elmina campus operational, Malaysia cloud region 'upcoming' (Nov 2026); Oracle region planned (US$6.5bn, Oct 2024); Alibaba Cloud DC since Oct 2017; Huawei and Tencent present
top_hubs: Johor (Johor Bahru, Kulai, Sedenak); Greater Kuala Lumpur (Cyberjaya, Elmina)

capacity_source: Cushman & Wakefield Vietnam release (Hanoi + HCMC; pipeline to 2030)

top_hubs: Ho Chi Minh City; Hanoi (Hoa Lac)
